nodes.summary: Every sequence in the Rellich ball has a subsequence converging in `ℓ²(ℕ, 𝕜)` to a point of the ball.
nodes.title: Rellich–Kondrachov, sequential form

nodes.summary: The Rellich ball is compact in `ℓ²(ℕ, 𝕜)`.
nodes.title: Rellich–Kondrachov, compactness form

nodes.summary: Canonical truncations land in the span of the first `N` basis vectors.
nodes.title: Truncations lie in the span of the first basis vectors

nodes.summary: If `x` is supported in a finite set `S` and its weighted sum over `S` is at most `M ^ 2`, then `x` lies in the Rellich ball.
nodes.title: Finitely supported sequences in the Rellich ball

nodes.summary: Membership in the Rellich ball: every finite weighted partial sum is bounded by `M ^ 2`.
nodes.title: Membership in the Rellich ball via partial sums

nodes.summary: The `ℓ²` norm squared is the sum of the squared coordinate norms.
nodes.title: Squared $\ell^2$ norm as a sum of squared coordinates

nodes.summary: The tail norm identity: the distance from `x` to its truncation is the `ℓ²` norm of the tail.
nodes.title: Tail norm identity for $\ell^2$ truncation

nodes.summary: The tail estimate: the squared distance from `x` to its truncation is at most `M ^ 2 / (1 + N ^ 2)`.
nodes.title: Tail estimate for the Rellich ball

nodes.summary: The Rellich ball only depends on `|M|`, since the bound is on `M ^ 2`.
nodes.title: Rellich ball depends only on the absolute radius

nodes.summary: The Rellich ball of radius `M`: sequences in `ℓ²(ℕ, 𝕜)` whose weighted `ℓ²` energy is at most `M ^ 2`.
nodes.title: Rellich ball of weighted square-summable sequences

nodes.summary: The Rellich ball is totally bounded in `ℓ²(ℕ, 𝕜)`.
nodes.title: Rellich–Kondrachov, total boundedness form

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
